summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries. The school district emphasizes the importance of preserving and improving the E-Rate program, not assuming it has reached its end.

claims.argument: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate would have direct and tangible impact on school budgets
claims.evidence_quote: We are located in Central Ohio near the Linden Area which is a lower income area. Many of my students do not have internet access at home and utilize the library a lot. We stretch not just every dollar but also every penny so when we need to cut areas sometimes technology suffer which is a huge hit to our students.

claims.requested_action: Reject proposals to sunset or eliminate the E-Rate program
claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to build connectivity necessary for modern education
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
